en.headline: Man steals gold necklace from Tai Po jewellery store while posing as customer
en.dek: Police are hunting a man in his forties who entered a Chow Sang Sang store on Kwong Fuk Road this afternoon, asked to try on a necklace worth tens of thousands of dollars, and fled with it.
body: Police are investigating a theft at a jewellery store in Tai Po this afternoon.

At about 3.11pm officers received a report from staff at the Chow Sang Sang store at 70 Kwong Fuk Road. A man aged about 40, wearing a black top, entered posing as a customer, asked to examine a gold necklace of about one tael, then snatched it and ran towards Kwong Fuk Lane.
The case is currently classified as theft. Police are searching for the suspect. The necklace is estimated to be worth several tens of thousands of Hong Kong dollars.
No one was injured in the incident.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福道金行男客試戴金鏈後偷走 警正追查
zh.dek: 警方正追查一名約40歲男子，今日下午進入廣福道周生生金行伊裝顧客，試戴一條約值數萬元金鏈後奪門逃走。
body: 警方今日調查大埔一宗金行盜竊案。
下午約3時11分，廣福道70號周生生金行職員報案，指一名約40歲、身穿黑色上衣的男子伊裝顧客進入店內，要求查看一條約一両重的金鏈，其後搶走金鏈往廣福里方向逃走。
案件暫列盜竊，警方正追缉涉案男子。被盜金鏈估計值數萬港元。
